mechanism.claim: When a completed high-variation BTC day moves opposite an unusually large same-date change in the lagged-published Crypto Fear & Greed index, market price is leading a slower behavioral measure rather than confirming it. Follow the completed BTC direction for one day as sentiment catches up.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed BTC UTC-day return
mechanism.why_distinct: FGER used static index extremes and contrarian fixed sides and was terminal at source support. FGPLR uses the change between consecutive index observations, exact same-date BTC direction disagreement, and price-lead continuation; it reuses no FGER event or diagnostic control and is not an extremity-threshold repair.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed BTC daily realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one sparse daily behavioral lead-lag clock is absent from Gross9 primitives.

features.sentiment_source: hash-bound Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed daily history already materialized outcome-blind
features.availability: index row labeled UTC date D is not usable until D+1 00:00 UTC; both D and D-1 rows must be exact consecutive dates
features.sentiment_change: Fear & Greed value[D] minus value[D-1]; strict nonzero
features.sentiment_change_rank: strict-prior midrank of absolute sentiment_change over at most 90 prior valid consecutive changes, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.60
features.btc_day_return: sum of exact 24 completed hourly BTC log returns with hour starts D 00:00 through 23:00; strict nonzero
features.direction_disagreement: strict sign(sentiment_change) equals negative strict sign(btc_day_return)
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact 24 completed hourly BTC log returns for date D)
features.volatility_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 valid daily decisions, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact D+1 00:00 UTC after lagged index publication rule and BTC day complete
clock.side: strict sign of completed BTC day return
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent behavioral-measure versus price lead-lag mechanism

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no lag, change, rank, disagreement, side, hold, clock, volatility, or subset repair.
